subtitle_zh: 来到史凯威，最先映入眼帘的，就是这座淘金者纪念雕像。
subtitle_en: Arriving in Skagway, the first thing we see is this Gold Rush monument.

subtitle_zh: 两位背着沉重行囊的淘金者，坚定地望向远方。
subtitle_en: Two prospectors carrying heavy packs look firmly into the distance.

subtitle_zh: 他们仿佛正准备翻越白隘口，踏上寻找黄金的漫漫征程。
subtitle_en: They seem ready to cross White Pass and begin the long search for gold.

subtitle_zh: 一百多年前，无数怀着梦想的人，就是从这里开始他们的淘金之旅。
subtitle_en: More than a century ago, countless dreamers began their Gold Rush journey here.

subtitle_zh: 铁路，是史凯威最重要的历史象征。
subtitle_en: The railroad is Skagway's most important historical symbol.

subtitle_zh: 街边展示着一节保存完好的白隘口铁路车厢。
subtitle_en: A well-preserved White Pass railcar is displayed along the street.

subtitle_zh: 它提醒着人们，这条铁路不仅改变了史凯威，也见证了克朗代克淘金热最辉煌的年代。
subtitle_en: It reminds us how this railway changed Skagway and witnessed the Klondike Gold Rush.

subtitle_zh: 下午，我们也将从这里登上这条传奇铁路，展开期待已久的白隘口观光之旅。
subtitle_en: This afternoon, we will board this legendary railway for the White Pass scenic ride.

subtitle_zh: 这座拥有金色圆顶的建筑，就是史凯威最著名的 Golden North Hotel，金北酒店。
subtitle_en: This building with the golden dome is Skagway's famous Golden North Hotel.

subtitle_zh: 它建于淘金热时期，至今仍是小镇最具代表性的历史建筑之一。
subtitle_en: Built during the Gold Rush, it remains one of the town's landmark historic buildings.

subtitle_zh: 据说，这座金色圆顶象征着当年淘金者对于财富与梦想的追求。
subtitle_en: The golden dome is said to symbolize the prospectors' pursuit of wealth and dreams.
